title: A Busy Day
text:
Anna wakes up at seven. She brushes her teeth and eats bread with coffee. Then she runs to the bus stop. The bus is late, so she waits for ten minutes.

At work, Anna writes emails and calls her friend Tom. At lunch, she reads a book in the park. After work, she cooks pasta for dinner.

questions.text: What does Anna eat with her coffee?
Who does Anna call at work?
What can you infer about Anna's morning?
Why is Anna probably tired at the end of the day?
options: She had a busy day with work and cooking

vocabulary.definition: stays in one place until something happens
looks at words and understands them

paragraph_translations: Anna acorda às sete. Ela escova os dentes e come pão com café. Depois, corre até o ponto de ônibus. O ônibus está atrasado, então ela espera dez minutos.
No trabalho, Anna escreve e-mails e liga para a amiga Tom. No almoço, ela lê um livro no parque. Depois do trabalho, ela cozinha macarrão para o jantar.
